texts.li: The wind has turned and there's ice at the edge of the trough. The herd is still out grazing, {PET_nameDef} furthest of all. {A_nameDef} wants as many hands as can be spared to go out together and bring them in to the barn while there's still light.

{A_nameDef} has been watching the sky all morning. "They'll want to be under a roof tonight," {A_nameDef} says, and asks the council for a few hands: out to the herd with ropes, and every head of it home before dark.

[fall] The last of the grazing is going brown, and the nights are long now. Where {A_nameDef} grew up, the whole household brought the herd home on the same day each fall, and ate together after. {A_nameDef} would like to do the same here.

[afterraid] The raid scattered the herd across the land: {PET_nameDef} is still out past the fields, and others with it. {A_nameDef} wants to gather them all in together before anything else finds them.
[snow] Snow's coming in sideways and half the herd is still out in it. {A_nameDef} is already at the door with the ropes, waiting for the council to say how many can go.

[colony:Traditional] The cold is coming, and with it the day the colony brings the herd home. {A_nameDef} has had the ropes coiled by the door since breakfast, and has been humming the old herding call all morning.

li.label: Bring the herd home together
li.outcome: Whoever could be spared went out with a rope. One by one the herd came in out of the weather, {PET_nameDef} last and loudest, and the barn door was shut on all of them by dark.

outcomes.li: [snow] They brought the herd in through the snow in a long line, people and animals both white to the knees, and stamped their feet in the barn doorway after.
[afterraid] They found the scattered ones in twos and threes across the land and walked them home past the marks the raid had left, counting heads the whole way.

li.label: {A_nameDef} brings them in alone
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went out alone with a rope over {A_possessive} shoulder, and brought the herd in a head at a time until the light went.

li.label: They'll find their own way in
li.outcome: The council left the herd to find its own way home. {A_nameDef} went out to the fence twice that evening to look at them standing in the weather, and came back in without a word.
